name: Field Mob
notes: The southern-soul side of the lane, and the entry that breaks most of crunk's rules on purpose. `session.halfTime` is **false** and the snare goes back to `backbeat_24` — the research says 84–96 straight with the backbeat on 2 and 4 — so the half-time skeleton the parent is built on is gone. Ghost snares on the "e" of beats are the highest-probability ghosts in this batch (0.34), the hats are continuous 8ths with an open hat on the "&" of 4, and `velocityTiers` come down to a live-feel range rather than crunk's hot flat one. ⛔ **The low end is a played bass, not the 808, and that is authored through `drums.bass808.role`.** The research says an electric-bass-style line with passing tones and octave jumps, and `bass::generate` returns nothing at all while the 808 claims the role of bassline — so `role` is `counter_riff`, which is the engine's only other value and here means "the 808 stops being the bassline". ⚠ That is an engine limit showing: `counter_riff` also lets the 808 keep whatever pitch it slid to, which is a UK-drill behaviour rather than a Jazze Pha one, and it is tolerable only because `slideProb` is 0.10. The real line is the `bassline` block — `independent_riff`, `followRootsProb` 0.50, passing tones through the 5th, 7th, 2nd and 6th, and cell shapes that walk 1–3–5. Harmony is 4-bar loops with real motion, both the major (I–vi–ii–V) and the minor (i–iv–VII–III) forms the research names, which is why `scales` leads with major and dorian: the degrees those numerals point at are only right in those modes. ⚠ `confidence` is medium and the inferred parameter is the harmony — the research documents the producer relationship and era, marks the tempo [LOW-CONF], and says the harmonic specifics are lane inference. ⚠ Fill fingerprint for this batch: `gapProb` 0.16 / `descendProb` 0.62 / `rampJitter` 19. ⛔ `session.scales` **widens** its parent's set rather than narrowing it: `major` and `dorian` are not among crunk's four, and the convention elsewhere is that an artist narrows its genre's scales and never reaches outside them. They are here because the research's harmony row says "major and dorian soul harmony" and the I–vi–ii–V family points at the wrong degrees without them. The real fix is a Dungeon-Family-adjacent southern-soul archetype to extend instead of crunk; until that exists this model is parked, which is what the research says the crunk container is for.
